_note: SpeedKills' ten hacks (src/game/hacks.ts, docs/PHASE_18_PLAN_SPEEDKILLS.md 7.7): one mobility and one utility, picked before the match; in the battle royale a copy found on the floor fuses (a level up, to fuseLevels) and another of the same slot swaps. `cooldowns` is seconds between uses at each fusion level, 0 to 4, where Hyper Scape's published numbers give them, measured as it was left: Teleport (our DASH) and Invisibility 12, 11, 10, 9, 7; Reveal 14 base and 9 maxed; Slam about 10 maxed; Wall 7 maxed. Where it published nothing (HEAL, ARMOR's cooldown, LEAP and GRAPPLE, which are ours), `cooldown` is ours and each level takes fuseStep of it off. Its other published numbers are used as they were: Invisibility lasts 10 s; Armor 5 s (after a patch cut it from 10; ours takes 60% of a hit away rather than all of it, as the owner chose); Reveal marks everyone within 60 m all round for 6 s; a Mine does 50. Sources: gamepur.com, pcgamesn.com, ggrecon.com and thegamer.com hack guides, 2020 and 2021. The keys: mobility on the ability key (F, a pad's LB), utility on the grenade key (G, a pad's RB), since SpeedKills carries no grenades.
